def factor_signed_path_efficiency_cycle_smooth_confirm_63(df):
    """Measure persistent directional price movement with a smoothed recent path confirmation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    net_move = close - close.shift(126)
    path_length = close.diff().abs().rolling(126, min_periods=126).sum()
    efficiency = net_move / path_length.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    recent_net_move = close - close.shift(63)
    recent_path_length = close.diff().abs().rolling(63, min_periods=63).sum()
    recent_efficiency = recent_net_move / recent_path_length.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    confirmation = recent_efficiency.abs().rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean()
    signal = efficiency * confirmation
    df_copy["factor_signed_path_efficiency_cycle_smooth_confirm_63"] = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_signed_path_efficiency_cycle_smooth_confirm_63"]
rationale: Mutation of the qualified signed path-efficiency parent. The long-horizon signed efficiency remains the core economic mechanism and preserves the parent's positive cost-adjusted payoff and low-turnover profile. The recent confirmation window is extended to 63 bars and its absolute efficiency is averaged over three trailing observations, reducing sensitivity to isolated path-shape fluctuations and targeting the weaker predictive stability metrics ICIR and RankICIR without adding a new feature family.
